voice.name: Open Sector - Rifleman
voice.description: Young male infantry private in his early twenties, eager and a little nervous, clear mid-range voice with a working-class accent, speaking fast and crisp like a soldier answering over a field radio, energetic and loyal.
voice.sample: Rifleman, ready for orders! Moving up to that ridge now, sir. Contact front, engaging! Keep your heads down, boys, we're going in.

fire.prompt: Single bolt-action rifle shot outdoors on a battlefield, sharp crack with short echo, close range, no music

move.prompt: Soldier's boots jogging on dirt with rifle sling and gear rattling, short burst of running footsteps, close, no music, no voice

reload.prompt: Bolt-action rifle reload, bolt pulled back, stripper clip pushed in, bolt closed, metallic clicks, close up
